description: Pipelines is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. Approximate centerline location of major energy transmission pipelines including the name of each pipeline. Coverage: Government of New Brunswick. The portal files it under the publisher Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. Its tags are pipeline, petroleum, gas, oil, Geonb. It offers 14 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - New Brunswick. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
